description: This file is a shell script used for testing git merge strategies, specifically the 'resolve' strategy. It accomplishes setup operations, executes merge commands, and verifies outcomes to ensure correct behavior.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expected to fail, indicating a negative test case.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test suite.
